question: Is accomplishment certain for one who performs oblations counted in hundreds of thousands?
premises: A practitioner performs oblations in lakh counts.
The text denies doubt regarding the resulting accomplishment.
inference: Performing oblations in lakhs certainly brings accomplishment.
uncertainties: The verb governing lakṣa+saṃkhyāni is implicit from context.
plain_english: Whoever performs oblations in hundreds of thousands, O goddess, attains accomplishment; there is no doubt.
